title: 100 hours, 100 songs
intro: i can’t fucking finish anything. so: 100 songs. one hour each. this is the first one.

sections.heading: why i’m doing this
paragraphs: i’ve become pretty disenchanted with life, honestly. and with the amount of AI slop everywhere. i’m tired of it. i want to make some music and actually have something finished at the end.
the finishing part is the problem. so i’m giving myself an hour per song. when the hour is up, that’s the song. i have to get it done.

sections.heading: one hour
paragraphs: i can still make decisions. i just can’t keep making them forever. there’s a point where i have to stop changing things and export the fucking file.
i don’t know if this will make finishing easier. that’s what i’m trying to find out. i’d like to spend less time stuck and more time making music.
i’m leaving it here as it is. i can make another song tomorrow.
